definitions.explanation: Extremely large in size, scale, or magnitude, far exceeding what is normal or expected.

examples.japanese: {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I can see a huge building.

examples.japanese: {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}している→接近する：25362_sekkinsuru⟧。
⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巨大|きょだい}な⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The Internet has had an enormous impact on society.

notes:
{巨大|きょだい}な emphasizes extreme, impressive size — something that dwarfs normal scale. It can describe physical objects (buildings, animals, structures) and abstract things (influence, organizations, problems). The word has a stronger impact than simply ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: giant corporation
- {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: huge market
- {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧: massive earthquake
- {巨大|きょだい}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: enormous power
- ⟦{巨大|きょだい}{化|か}→巨大化：26010_kyodaika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grow enormous

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: big; large — neutral, everyday word for size without the extreme emphasis
- ⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧な: vast; enormous — typically used for quantities, amounts, and data rather than physical size
- ⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧な: immense; enormous — primarily used for money and abstract quantities
- ⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧な: grand; magnificent — adds a nuance of grandeur and impressiveness
